name: web-design-suite
description: A professional web design and front-end architecture toolkit — tokens, spacing discipline, style architecture, accessibility, and runnable validators that fail the build on drift.

plugins.name: web-design-suite
plugins.description: Thirteen skills for designing and building websites that stay coherent under multiple developers. A closed token system with obsessive spacing discipline, one styling home per component, cascade layers instead of specificity fights, measured WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, a gated protocol for inventing new interaction patterns, and runnable validators. Covers migrating an inherited codebase onto tokens, syncing with Figma, designing and building, schema-to-screens scaffolding, pages that convert, HTML email, state proof sheets, performance budgets, self-generating docs, a runtime accessibility gate, semver for the token system, an adversarial critique, and the client presentation that argues the decisions.
